aboutGame.title: What is Kidnap and Jail?
paragraphs: Kidnap and Jail is a fast-paced multiplayer action game on Roblox where players face off in an intense sandbox pursuit arena. Whether you take on the role of a cunning captor tracking bounties across the city or a daring fugitive evading capture, every match tests your tactical reflexes, teamwork, and spatial awareness.

From mastering restraint tools and high-speed getaway vehicles to orchestrating high-stakes prison breakouts through hidden ducts and picking security locks, our comprehensive wiki delivers verified guides, gameplay strategies, and the latest codes to keep you ahead of rival squads.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Kidnap and Jail.

items.question: What is Kidnap and Jail?
items.answer: Kidnap and Jail is a fast-paced multiplayer action game on Roblox where players compete to capture opponents, secure cash bounties, and execute daring prison breakouts.

items.question: How do I redeem promo codes in Kidnap and Jail?
items.answer: To redeem codes in Kidnap and Jail, enter a safe zone, open the codes menu via the Twitter or gift box icon, paste an active code, and claim free rewards.

items.question: What are the main playable roles in Kidnap and Jail?
items.answer: Players in Kidnap and Jail take on roles including Captors who hunt bounties, Fugitives who evade arrest, Inmates who stage prison breaks, and Rescuers who free teammates.

items.question: How can inmates break out of cells in Kidnap and Jail?
items.answer: Inmates in Kidnap and Jail can break out by acquiring lockpicks, crawling through hidden ventilation shafts, dodging patrolling guards, or receiving rescue assistance from teammates.

items.question: Is Kidnap and Jail supported on PC and mobile devices?
items.answer: Yes, Kidnap and Jail supports cross-platform play across PC with keyboard and mouse, mobile devices with touchscreen buttons, and console controllers.
